gaps.sentence: She goes to the gym twice ___ week.
gaps.explanation: 'Twice a week' — rates take 'a' (= per). The other gap is 'the gym'.
Single mountain peaks take no article: Everest, Mont Blanc (compare: the Alps).

gaps.sentence: ___ problem is that people don't recycle enough.
gaps.explanation: The problem (the one we are discussing); people in general takes no article.

gaps.sentence: He demands ___ answer before the end of the day.
We visited ___ Louvre on our last morning in Paris.
gaps.explanation: Most famous buildings and monuments take 'the': the Louvre, the Eiffel Tower.
Plural general nouns and flu (illness name) take no article.

gaps.sentence: ___ water in this bottle tastes strange.
gaps.explanation: The of/in-phrase makes the noun definite: the water in this bottle.

gaps.sentence: We had ___ wonderful time in Prague.
gaps.explanation: 'Have a wonderful/great/good time' — 'time' here is countable and takes 'a'.
